Class Row

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.table.Row
public final class Row extends Object
A row in a Table.

A row is a collection of Cells with optional styling and height configuration. 

// Simple row
Row.from(Cell.from("Name"), Cell.from("Age"))

// Row from strings
Row.from("Alice", "30")

// Styled row
Row.from("Header1", "Header2").style(Style.EMPTY.bold())

// Row with custom height
Row.from("Tall", "Row").height(3)
